meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 该技能会检查本地安装的 LazyCodex 和 Codex 命令行工具，与最新源码逐一对比版本、配置、插件等，输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 体检报告，并给出修复建议。它只诊断，不擅自改动你的安装。
howto.when: 当你要求做体检或健康检查，提到 LazyCodex、Codex 等关键词，或怀疑安装过期、损坏、配置改动后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 给我的 LazyCodex 安装做个健康检查
say.note: 输出一份带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 对比一下本地 Codex 和最新版，看有没有过期
say.note: 会同步最新源码并对比版本

say.text: 刚改了配置后 Codex 行为怪，帮我查查
say.note: 会检查配置和插件接线，指出问题

howto.what_en: This skill checks the locally installed LazyCodex and Codex CLI against the latest sources, comparing versions, config, plugins, etc., then outputs an evidence-backed PASS/WARN/FAIL report with remediation steps. It only diagnoses and never mutates your install.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor/health check, mention LazyCodex, Codex, or similar keywords, or suspect a stale, broken, or drifted setup after an install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex install
Compare my local Codex with the latest version
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources and compares versions

say_en.text: Codex works oddly after a config change, investigate
say_en.note: Checks config and plugin wiring, points out issues
